en-US.longDescription:
Hermes Desktop is a native desktop app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent — a self-improving AI assistant with tool use, multi-platform messaging, and a closed learning loop.
Instead of managing the CLI by hand, the app walks through install, provider setup, and day-to-day usage in one place. It uses the official Hermes install script, stores Hermes in ~/.hermes, and gives you a GUI for chat, sessions, profiles, memory, skills, tools, scheduling, messaging gateways, and more.
en-US.name: Hermes Agent
en-US.releaseNotes:
Hermes Desktop v0.7.8 catches up with Hermes Agent v0.23.1 while retaining older Agent installation support.
- Supports current Agent approvals, multi-question clarification, cancellation and reconnect restoration across Local, SSH and Remote connections.
- Keeps sensitive tool prompts in native dialogs and recommends a Desktop update when an Agent requires a newer protocol.
- Follows Agent-managed runtimes, verifies pinned installers, refreshes runtime paths after installation and supports fresh backends before session history exists.
- Preserves the Agent-selected Windows interpreter so raw helper output is captured correctly, while background commands remain hidden.
- Preserves clarification ownership across runtime changes and restores current Agent tool activity in saved history.
- Patches Electron to 44.9.1, limits packaged files to the runtime payload and includes the Linux arm64 update feed.
Also includes the accumulated improvements since v0.7.7: live chat subagents, transcript and scrolling fixes, expanded Remote management, schedule history, shared pets, MiniMax speech, RTL improvements and Persian support.
Desktop and Agent update independently. Updating Desktop does not silently replace a Remote Agent or downgrade a newer local installation.
Validation covered the signed app in Local, SSH and Remote modes, genuine managed Agent installations on Windows/Linux, and native installer/updater checks on Windows, Intel macOS and Linux x64/arm64. See the acceptance record for candidate identities and coverage limits.

zh-CN.longDescription:
Hermes Desktop 是一款原生的桌面应用程序，用于安装、配置并与 Hermes Agent 进行聊天——这是一款具备工具调用、多平台消息传递和闭环学习能力的自我进化的 AI 助手。
无需手动管理命令行界面 (CLI)，该应用可在一个统一界面中引导您完成安装、提供商设置以及日常使用。它使用官方的 Hermes 安装脚本，将 Hermes 存储在 ~/.hermes 目录下，并为您提供涵盖聊天、会话、配置、记忆、技能、工具、计划任务、消息网关等功能的图形界面。
